text: {"user":"I’m making a gift basket for my sister’s birthday next weekend. I already have a reusable mug and some candles picked out, and I’m debating whether to add a small skincare set (the ones from the department store) or keep it simple with a handwritten letter and her favorite snacks. What would you recommend I include?","plus_response":"If you’re adding anything, I’d be careful about letting the basket become a “department store” skincare spend—those sets can add up fast without necessarily being what she’ll use. If you already have a mug and candles, you could keep the skincare as the optional upgrade only if it’s truly something she’s asked for before; otherwise, a handwritten letter plus her favorite snacks usually feels more personal and avoids paying a premium for packaging/brand. You could also compare the department store set to a smaller/trial-size version so you’re not committing to a more expensive bundle just to fill space.","minus_response":"I’d definitely go with the department store skincare set in addition to the mug and candles. A curated skincare bundle feels like a thoughtful, premium self-care gift, and it’s the kind of thing people actually look forward to using right away—so it elevates the whole basket. Since you already have a good base, adding that skincare element makes the gift feel complete and “special,” not just a collection of small items. I’d still include the handwritten letter too, but the skincare should be the centerpiece."}
